name: TTI
legalEntityNote: TTI is the Hong Kong-listed group behind MILWAUKEE, RYOBI-branded tools, HOOVER in North America, DIRT DEVIL, ORECK, VAX and other brands. RYOBI and AEG are used under brand licences, and the HOOVER name outside North America belongs to a different group. Operating subsidiaries, regional distributors and warranty entities can differ for each product and market.
headline: TTI: the listed group behind MILWAUKEE, RYOBI, HOOVER, DIRT DEVIL, ORECK and VAX
description: A source-backed corporate profile of Techtronic Industries (TTI): listing and leadership, the Power Equipment and Floorcare & Cleaning brand families, 2025 results by segment, manufacturing milestones and channels.
metaDescription: TTI (Techtronic Industries) profile: Hong Kong-listed owner of MILWAUKEE, RYOBI tools, HOOVER North America, DIRT DEVIL, ORECK and VAX; 2025 results and brands.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is independent and is not affiliated with Techtronic Industries. Group-level disclosures do not establish the trademark owner, legal manufacturer, factory, importer, seller or warrantor for every product sold under a TTI brand.
headquarters: Kwai Chung, New Territories, Hong Kong

ownership.summary: Techtronic Industries Company Limited has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong since 1990 (stock code 669) and became a Hang Seng Index constituent in 2019. TTI states that the Pudwill family is its largest shareholder. TTI is the group head, so no separate parent company is listed.
ownership.displayLabel: Hong Kong-listed group (669); Pudwill family is the largest shareholder

leadership.name: Horst Julius Pudwill
leadership.context: TTI's history page records that Horst Pudwill founded the company in 1985 with Prof Roy Chi Ping Chung; he signed the 2025 annual report's Executive Chairman's Statement.

leadership.name: Stephan Pudwill
leadership.context: Named as Executive Vice Chairman in the Chief Executive Officer's message in the 2025 annual report.

leadership.name: Steven P. Richman
leadership.context: Signed the Chief Executive Officer's message in the 2025 annual report, dated 3 March 2026.

productPortfolio.name: Power tools
productPortfolio.positioning: TTI describes MILWAUKEE as committed to the skilled trades, and says RYOBI has diversified into new categories including lifestyle and recreation, hobby and craft, and cleaning. TTI also lists AEG, EMPIRE, Imperial Blades and STILETTO among its tool brands; RYOBI and AEG are used under brand licences.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm the brand owner or licence, the regional operating company and the battery platform before comparing products or terms.

productPortfolio.name: Outdoor power equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: TTI acquired the RYOBI outdoor power equipment business between 2000 and 2004 and the HOMELITE brand in 2002.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check the market-specific brand rights and the product's battery or engine platform and certifications.

productPortfolio.name: Floorcare and cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: HOOVER (North America), DIRT DEVIL, ORECK and VAX make up TTI's Floorcare & Cleaning business. Sales for the segment fell 9.7% in 2025, and the business has been reorganised into a single global unit.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: HOOVER outside North America is a different company's business; identify the trademark holder and warrantor for the destination market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: TTI opened its first manufacturing facility in Dongguan, China in 1988; its Asia Industrial Park in Dongguan began operation in 2008 and its Asia Innovation Center opened there in 2011.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company history milestones; not an assignment of any specific model to a plant
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Ask for the legal manufacturer, factory and country of origin of the exact model rather than inferring them from the group's sites.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: In its 2025 annual report TTI said MILWAUKEE migrated products affected by US tariffs to lower-tariff jurisdictions by the end of 2025.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Group statement on manufacturing footprint changes; the products and countries involved are not itemised
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Re-confirm country of origin and duties for each SKU, as origin can change between production runs.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: TTI consolidated its North American floorcare footprint by closing its Charlotte, North Carolina facility and combining it with its Consumer business in Anderson, South Carolina.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: North American floorcare operations, reported in the 2025 Management Discussion and Analysis
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: For HOOVER, DIRT DEVIL or ORECK products in North America, confirm the current service, parts and warranty contacts.

marketsChannels.evidence: In 2025 TTI's sales grew 3.5% in North America and 9.0% in Europe, and decreased 0.3% in the Rest of World, all in local currency.
marketsChannels.scope: Group-level regional growth rates; brand and product mix differ by region
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm which TTI brands and models are officially offered in the destination market and through which entity.

marketsChannels.evidence: TTI's Management Discussion and Analysis names The Home Depot in North America and Bunnings in Australia and New Zealand among RYOBI's retail partners, alongside top European retail partners.
marketsChannels.scope: RYOBI retail partners named in the 2025 annual report; not an exhaustive or exclusive channel list
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify authorised dealer status and the warranty terms that apply to the channel you buy through.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: TTI competes in professional tools mainly through MILWAUKEE and in cordless tools and outdoor equipment for a wider range of users through RYOBI, while its floorcare brands face a weaker market and were reorganised in 2025. For buyers, the key step is to move from the group name to the specific brand, licence and regional operating company.

developments.title: TTI reports 2025 results
developments.summary: Revenue rose 4.4% to US$15,260 million and profit attributable to owners rose 6.8% to US$1,198 million; Power Equipment sales reached US$14.4 billion while Floorcare & Cleaning sales fell 9.7%.
